notes: Rebuilds current-position inference around a recurring payment ledger: dynamic ACH descriptions are clustered, cadence is inferred, each funding deposit is assigned once, replacements and paid-off streams are detected, and confidence evidence is shown. Underwriters can correct status or lender names in Pricing Advisor; reusable aliases sync privately. The aggregate model is retrained as model 2.2.0 after reprocessing all 927 saved historical records.
